context: Request: track year over year the share of executed credit-agreement financings with an always-on (not springing) financial maintenance covenant, bucketed by signing year. Rubric: 12 financings (1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1008-00001, 1010-00001, 1012-00001, 1013-00001, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1036-00001, 1038-00002, 1042-00001, 1043-00001) each in its year bucket, the year-over-year shares, and a population-precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the silent cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store. Counts and lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for request words and agreement words; about 1,300 hits printed.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Narrower file-name pattern for agreement and facility names; about 120 hits saved to a file.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide scan times out; a scan over the saved file-name list follows, then a summary script that keeps only files whose names mark them as executed.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide scan rerun in five matter-number batches after a first attempt returns nothing and a second times out.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Reads the openings of ten executed agreements from ten matters, then a snippet script over several of them.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads ten agreements at a fixed later offset; most passages returned are definitions and mechanics.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes year-by-year counts and shares over sixteen agreements, with exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and checks the arithmetic.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: One required agreement was filtered out by file name and never opened; the answer excludes another it had read and counts several agreements outside the population, so the yearly shares are off.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its saved file-name list included one required agreement, but the summary script kept only files whose names marked them as executed, which dropped that agreement; the later batch scan listed the matter again and it was never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The scan-stage review said the execution-name filter could drop executed agreements named differently; the agent reran a full batch scan but never opened the matter.

other_errors.why: It read a required matter's executed agreement (evidence seen at [52]-[62] and [69]-[79]) but the answer excludes it as a project-style facility.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review said the yearly denominator is likely incomplete; the check stage only re-read the arithmetic.

other_errors.why: The answer counts several agreements outside the requested population (amendment, take-back and other facilities), which also skews the yearly shares.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review warned about counting drafts or unsigned agreements without naming these ones.

runs.failure_point: One required matter surfaced in the file-name scan but was never opened; the answer excludes two opened matters and counts several agreements outside the population.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its file-name list and the scan over it listed a required matter, but when choosing agreements to read it worked from execution-named files and never opened that matter.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) Reviews said about 60 surfaced matters were unopened and, after writing, that the population may be incomplete, without naming this matter; the check stages only reworked a duplicate.

other_errors.why: Two required matters it had opened (evidence seen at [49]-[78]) are excluded in the answer as property-secured and project-style facilities.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The reading-stage review said one of them was classified both as springing and as an excluded type; the agent resolved it by excluding it.

other_errors.why: The answer counts several agreements outside the requested population, including facility types the reading-stage review called out as outside scope.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The reading-stage review said several facility types were counted as core facilities without confirming scope; they stayed in the count.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the write stage: each counted agreements outside the requested population (precision and shares fail) and excluded one to three agreements it had opened. Each also lost one required matter before reading: T0 through a file-name filter in its scan stage (over-narrow-filter), T1 and T2 by choosing which matters to list or read from execution-named files (surfaced-not-opened). The critic named the filtering in T0 and T1 and a scope doubt in T2 at the reading stage; the runs reran scans or moved on, and no review named the extra agreements as such.
